plan: At cost 5, use 12 in normal and low demand; in high demand, choose 13–14, favoring 14 when rivals are near 13–14. At cost 6, use 12 as the normal and low-demand baseline; consider 13 when rivals price higher. At cost 8, test 12 as a baseline and reassess profit and units.
